Landed on origin/main f2580710a. Docs and tools/filmfestival only; no Scala.
Freezes: description 3c6b4442d, mapping 8515bdb6a. Four runs complete (auto, norecord x Opus 5.5, Haiku 5.5): 19 participant-sessions, 3,226 utterances, 63 calls each.
Primary (Opus 5.5, strict referent, participant average): automatic 78.5% [75.2, 81.3] / 78.9% by session; annotation-assisted 86.4 / 84.8; no record 36.9 / 33.0. Within one scene: 94.1 / 94.7 automatic.
Paired auto - annotation, session 1: strict -8.0 [-10.0, -6.2], within one -1.5. Haiku auto 74.3 / 70.0.
Independent check: all numbers reproduced by a separate scorer; 76 reply files replay byte-identically; no call before its freeze; no annotation leak. Post hoc: positional rule scores 33% strict / 66% within one (the real floor); loss is in scenes under 10 s; clock explains at most 1-2 points.
Instrument reviewed twice before any call (3 blocking defects fixed, incl. unlike 'near' measures).
Results: docs/plans/2026-11-10-filmfestival-automatic-input-results.md.
Follow-ups: add the positional rule to ff_baselines.py; last-scene interval of film 10 covers only credits; stale untracked caption-manifest.json draft in data dir; denser frame sampling untested.
